==About me==

''Okay, so my name is Josh. &nbsp;I am&nbsp;29 years old and have been a fan of the Wheel of Time since my sophomore year in high school in 1995.&nbsp; I followed the series religiously for the next six years up until Crossroads of Twilight came out.&nbsp; During this period of time I grew very impatient and angry with how slow Robert Jordan was coming out with new books in the series while at the same time coming out with prequels (New Spring).&nbsp; Now, don't get me wrong, I LOVE&nbsp;the idea of prequels, but not until the main series is FINISHED.&nbsp; Around this time I quit&nbsp;reading the series and decided that I would read it again once it was all&nbsp;finished.&nbsp;I constantly jibed my friends who continued to wait&nbsp;with claims that Robert Jordan was going to die before he ever finished the series.&nbsp; I had no idea that I would be proved right.''

Anyway, since I heard about Brandon Sanderson picking up the helm to finish the series I reread all the books I had read before as well as KoD in preparation for The&nbsp;Gathering Storm.&nbsp; My interest in the series has been substantially reinvigorated and I can't wait for Towers of Midnight and Memory of Light.

My favorite characters in the series are Mat, Moiraine, Rand, and&nbsp;Egwene (although I used to hate Egwene with a fiery passion.&nbsp; I have since learned to love her character, although I am admittedly hopeful that Rand gets the opportunity to take her down a few pegs.&nbsp; I just love it when he does that with the women.&nbsp; After all, he's the M.F.'ing Dragon Reborn!)
